item.description: ### Added - **Muse Code, Meta's coding agent, now shows up in Perch.** Every open `muse` terminal gets a row — working, finished, interrupted or closed — with the first thing you asked as its title, and a "finished" notification carrying Muse's closing reply. A new folder waiting on Muse's "Do you trust this workspace?" question shows as "Waiting for you to trust this folder". Perch adds its hooks to `~/.config/muse/settings.json` beside your own, and Remove Integration takes them out again. Replying, Stop and approvals for Muse come in a later update; the iPhone and Watch show Muse sessions once the companion app is updated.
